item.title: Local LLMs — Mastodon daily top — Ollama gets parallel serving; iGPUs and Mac minis prove viable (22 Nov)
item.description:
• Ollama 0.14 now handles parallel requests per model by default; one user serves three people from a single RTX 3090 at about 35 tok/s each.
  • Modest hardware keeps getting more capable: llama.cpp's Vulkan backend runs an 8B Qwen model at 18 tok/s on a Radeon 780M iGPU, beating ROCm on the same laptop.
  • A month-long switch from ChatGPT to a 32 GB Mac mini M4 with Open WebUI covers summarising and proofreading, but not coding.
  • Privacy warning: several desktop LLM apps send telemetry by default, so 'local' is not automatically private.
  • Practical tips and questions: moving Ollama's model store to an external SSD, small models for email classification, and whether a Raspberry Pi 5 can run LocalAI.

1. Ollama 0.14 enables parallel requests by default

Mira (@mira@example.social) · 🔁 41 · ⭐ 96 · 💬 18 · 🖼 1

Ollama 0.14 finally does parallel requests per model by default. My 3090 now serves three users on a 14B model at ~35 tok/s each. Notes: example.org/ollama-parallel

2. 'Local' isn't automatically private: check app telemetry

Sam (@sam@example.social) · 🔁 30 · ⭐ 44 · 💬 11

CW: AI / privacy

Reminder that "local" isn't automatically private: several popular desktop LLM apps still send telemetry by default. Check settings before pasting work documents.

3. A month of replacing ChatGPT with a Mac mini M4

Camille (@camille@example.fr) · 🔁 17 · ⭐ 64 · 💬 22

I replaced my ChatGPT subscription with a Mac mini M4 with 32 GB and Open WebUI. After a month: for summarising PDFs and correcting my writing, it's more than enough. For code, I'm still keeping a cloud model.

Original (fr)

J'ai remplacé mon abonnement ChatGPT par un Mac mini M4 avec 32 Go et Open WebUI. Après un mois : pour résumer des PDF et corriger mes textes, ça suffit largement. Pour le code, je garde encore un modèle cloud.

4. llama.cpp Vulkan beats ROCm on a Radeon 780M iGPU

Jonas (@jonas@example.de) · 🔁 22 · ⭐ 51 · 💬 9

Small benchmark: llama.cpp with the Vulkan backend on a Radeon 780M (iGPU). Qwen 8B Q4_K_M runs at 18 tokens/s, faster than ROCm on the same machine. Genuinely usable for laptops without a dedicated GPU.

Original (de)

Kleiner Benchmark: llama.cpp mit Vulkan-Backend auf einer Radeon 780M (iGPU). Qwen 8B Q4_K_M läuft mit 18 Token/s – schneller als ROCm auf derselben Maschine. Für Laptops ohne dGPU echt brauchbar.

5. Move Ollama's model folder to an external SSD

Kenta (@kenta@example.jp) · 🔁 9 · ⭐ 20 · 💬 2

How to change where Ollama stores models to an external SSD: just set the OLLAMA_MODELS environment variable and restart. Freed up 200 GB on my internal disk.

Original (ja)

Ollamaのモデル保存先を外付けSSDに変更する方法：環境変数 OLLAMA_MODELS を設定して再起動するだけ。内蔵ディスクが200GB空きました。

6. Which small model for local email classification?

Lucia (@lucia@example.es) · 🔁 3 · ⭐ 12 · 💬 27

Question: which small model do you use to classify emails locally? I tried Gemma 4B and Phi mini; Gemma is more accurate in Spanish, but slower.

Original (es)

Pregunta: ¿qué modelo pequeño usáis para clasificar correos en local? Probé Gemma 4B y Phi mini; Gemma acierta más en español, pero es más lento.

7. Is LocalAI on a Raspberry Pi 5 worth it?

Anna (@anna@example.de) · 🔁 0 · ⭐ 2 · 💬 4

Does anyone have experience with LocalAI on a Raspberry Pi 5? Is it even worth it?

Original (de)

Hat jemand Erfahrung mit LocalAI auf einem Raspberry Pi 5? Lohnt sich das überhaupt?
